verdict.reasoning:
I independently recomputed the CAI distribution from the project's own bundled artifact (00_source_archive/local/資料集剖析/samples/ntu_creditcard__step5_cai.parquet, n=99), whose min/max match the range certified in 17 §八 to the last decimal (−43.665943 ~ +54.590571). All three assertions in line 462 fail on that data: skewness = +0.128 (slightly RIGHT-skewed, not 左偏; excess kurtosis only +0.557); Shapiro-Wilk p = 0.628; KS vs N(0,15) D = 0.0720, p = 0.657; Anderson-Darling 0.418 < 0.555 (15% critical value) — N(0,15²) is not rejected, so "與 N(0,15²) 不合" is false; and the maximum CDF deviation is 7.14 pp (equal to the KS D), with the chart's headline number (share decelerating) off by only 4.5 pp (empirical 45.5% vs 50.0%) — far from "第幾百分位全部算錯". The direction claim is self-refuting on its own cited evidence: the quoted range is asymmetric to the RIGHT (+54.6 vs −43.7); the tails are merely −2.6σ / +3.2σ, wide only because sd = 17.

I tried to rescue the claim two ways. (1) Provenance: 00_source_archive/local/大數據行銷IB5082/03_作業題目與評分標準.md:791 does say CAI is 左偏長尾, but as a derivation from the estimator's support (upper bound 100, lower bound unbounded) — a legitimate 推導 claim. Line 462 transplants it into a sentence describing 課程資料集 and places it adjacent to a 【實測】 tag, which is exactly the 推導/實測 mislabelling that 00_通則 forbids. (2) Practical consequence: at the 5%/95% cut used downstream (source §4.10, 切非常活躍/不活躍群), σ=15 gives cutoffs ±24.67 and selects 6 low / 10 high instead of 5 / 5 — the high tail doubles. That is a genuine reason not to copy σ=15, but it justifies "重估參數", not "全部算錯", and says nothing about skew or normality. At the 20/80 cut the two methods are near-identical (−12.30/+11.46 vs −12.62/+12.62).

Severity: important, agreeing with the claimant. Not critical — the prescriptive half of the cell (use the empirical CDF, or data-estimated μ̂/σ̂ with the choice stated in the figure note) is correct, and following it produces a sound analysis; nothing downstream computes wrong numbers. But this is a report-authoring reference: a user reads the cell and writes "CAI 分布左偏長尾、不符常態" into a deliverable — a statement anyone can refute in one line of scipy against the project's own dataset — and it carries the skill system's highest-trust 【實測】 framing. Not minor for that reason. Recommended fix matches the claimant's, plus one addition: retain the support-based skew argument but tag it 【推導】 rather than deleting it, since it is the honest justification for the "不要照抄 σ=15" discipline. Separately noted (out of scope): references/00_通則與紀律.md:395 states "CAI 未轉換，偏度 −1.83（左偏）" in a worked M4 example, which conflicts with the measured +0.128 on the same dataset.

problem: 數學上是反的。帽子矩陣對角元 h_ii = 1/n + (x_i−x̄)′S⁻¹(x_i−x̄)/(n−1)，在 X 的重心取最小值 1/n，離重心越遠越大，平均恰為 (k+1)/n。所以 h 小 = 該點落在 X 的正中央，正是「一點都不孤立」；X 空間的孤立點對應的是 h 大。2(k+1)/n 與 3(k+1)/n 在標準教科書裡都是「高槓桿」的警戒上界，不是「孤立」的下界判準。素材 digest 自己就標註過這件事（01_eda_regression_anova.md §4.6【評註】：「第二條『h 小於下界也要檢查』是這份筆記獨有的說法（一般教科書只講上界）」），08 抄過來時把保留條款丟掉，變成無條件硬規則；而 08 §4.1 引用 HOMES4a 時又只用上界（「三個點在上方虛線以上」），前後不一致。
how_verified: 帽子矩陣的代數性質（Σh_ii=k+1、min h_ii=1/n、平均=(k+1)/n）；並回讀 00_source_archive/notion/商管統計資料分析/01_eda_regression_anova.md 第 1253-1261 行的原文與該處【評註】。
fix: 改成「$h > 3(k+1)/n$ 需檢查；$2(k+1)/n \le h \le 3(k+1)/n$ 為灰帶」，並在表註保留 digest 的原話與保留條款：「講義另有一條『h 低於 2(k+1)/n 也要查』，是該筆記獨有說法，一般教科書只講上界；本 skill 兩條線都畫，但判定只用上界。」

verdict.reasoning:
Independently confirmed. Verified the algebra numerically at the material's own dimensions (n=148, k=5): sum(h_ii)=6.0 exactly =k+1, mean h=0.04054 exactly =(k+1)/n, min h≈1/n, and corr(h, distance-from-X-centroid)=+0.958. A deliberately planted far-from-centroid point got h=0.584, i.e. far ABOVE 3(k+1)/n=0.122, not below 2(k+1)/n. Meanwhile 97.3% of all points fall below 2(k+1)/n. So line 190's "h < 2(k+1)/n 代表該點很孤立也要查" is exactly backwards (low h = at the centre of X space) and operationally absurd (flags ~97% of the dataset into sensitivity analysis). Provenance claim also checks out: 00_source_archive/notion/商管統計資料分析/01_eda_regression_anova.md L1256 carries the line and L1259-1261 attaches the 評註 flagging it as unique to that note; 08 L190 kept the assertion and dropped the reservation, promoting it to an unconditional cell in the 「什麼算有問題」 column.

Tried and failed to refute: (a) "08 is faithfully transcribing MBA5045" — the digest never endorsed the interpretation, only suggested drawing both lines, and 08 L223 shows this same file marks non-standard content with 【推導，待驗證】, so the omission breaks the project's own convention; (b) "05 and 08 agree" — they do not: references/05_資料特徵檢驗.md:543 keeps the caveat 「這條下界是這份筆記獨有的說法，一般教科書只講上界」 while 08 L190 does not, violating 08 L181's own explicit invariant 「ref 05 §7.1 已列同一張表，兩處必須保持一致」; (c) "08 §4.1 is consistent" — no, L209 counts only 三個高槓桿點 using the upper bound only, an internal contradiction.

Severity held at important rather than raised or lowered. Lowering considered: I traced the code path and templates/迴歸建模_程式範本.py:78 sets is_influential from Cook's D alone, and sensitivity() is driven by is_influential, so the is_isolated flag is inert — no computed number in any deliverable is corrupted. That makes it a doc/teaching error, not a numeric one. But it stays important because it is an unambiguously false mathematical claim stated as a hard rule in the file's primary diagnostic table, it contradicts both ref 05 and 08's own §4.1, and it is echoed in the code at templates/迴歸建模_程式範本.py:62 ("低於此代表該點很孤立，也要檢查") and in the is_isolated column name, so a user reads the wrong concept off the script output too. Not critical: nothing silently miscomputes and an analyst would notice 97% of rows flagged.

One refinement to the proposed fix: the reporter's replacement note still frames the lower bound as merely "該筆記獨有說法", which understates it — the stated rationale is backwards, not just non-standard. The fix should say so and should touch three places: references/08_迴歸建模.md:190, references/05_資料特徵檢驗.md:543, and templates/迴歸建模_程式範本.py:62,77.

04 §七 的 SQL 是使用者實際會跑、用來產出那個數字的 checker；而 09 §1.1 把「CAI 覆蓋率 ≥60%」設成硬閘門（<60% 則「CAI 不得作為分群輸入變數，也不得作為建議依據」）。定義閘門的檔（00/09）說「算得出」= ≥3 個去重購買日，產生閘門輸入值的檔（04）說 = ≥2 個 —— 閘門輸入與閘門刻度用不同尺，是功能性缺陷不只是行文不一致。04:346 的判定範本「✅ 做 顧客價值分群（…99/100 顧客算得出 CAI）」與 00:488「每人 <3 筆 → CAI 不可用」可直接對貼成矛盾，而 99% 還掛著 skill 最高可信度的【實測對照】標記。09 §九 維護條款本身就要求「門檻數字改了必須同時改出處」，這正是該條款要防的失效。

對方誇大之處
不是三個互斥版本，是兩個。07:130 的「n_intervals < 5 → N/A」與 04:390 的 has_cai_reliable（>=6 天 = ≥5 間隔）**互相吻合**，04 已正確做了兩層。真衝突只在第一層（≥2 vs ≥3），外加 09 的「覆蓋率 ≥60%」沒指明是哪一層覆蓋率（99% 還是 89%）。另有一個小瑕疵：04:388 註解說「2–5 個間隔算出的 CAI 極不穩定」，但可信門檻是 ≥5 間隔 —— 5 同時被說成不穩定又可信，差一格。

嚴重度
維持 important。壓低的因素：本 repo 兩份資料集上三個數字都遠高於 60%，沒有決策翻盤，只影響 2/100 列，修法是幾行。但拉高的因素更關鍵：(a) 這是 checker SQL 產出、直接餵進硬閘門的數字；(b) 錯誤數字掛著【實測對照】標記，會侵蝕整套驗證標記的可信度；(c) 具體翻盤情境成立 —— 低頻零售資料若 ≥3 天覆蓋率 58%、≥2 天 62%，跑 04 的 SQL 會過閘、讓 CAI 進分群矩陣，而 09 明文禁止。

建議修法大致認同：在 17 §4.2 釘死唯一門檻（≥3 個去重購買日 = 算得出；≥6 天/≥5 間隔 = 可信、可進分群輸入，正是 04 已有的兩欄），04:387 改 >= 3、04:346/365/399 的 99% 改 97% 並同時列 89%，04:375 的「n_i ≥ 2」一併改，04:388 的「2–5」改「2–4」，09 §1.1 的「覆蓋率 ≥60%」指明適用哪一層，07:130 改為引用 17。

`skill/行銷數據分析/templates/cluster_spec.json:54` 的 `_validation_門檻` 寫著：「bootstrap_ari_median >= 0.60 才可用…；**min_cluster_pct >= 5% 且最小群 >= 30 人**；hdbscan_ari > 0.6 = 可信。不過關走 07 §7.3 的降級階梯。」也就是說，把 07 §5.4 的範例照抄進專案，會直接違反本 skill 自己出貨的驗證規格。示範檔與驗證檔互相打臉。

- 09_行銷_顧客價值.md:233「每期每狀態人數 n ≥ 30【素材門檻：`gap-business-translation.md` BT-07 表「分群 每群 n ≥ 30」】」——有明確素材出處，(b) 不是憑空推導

- templates/群命名體例.md:27 把 3.4%（5 人）那群標成「未過可執行性檢驗」——範本檔的態度是對的，反而是 07 §5.4 錯

**我試著推翻它，三條路都走不通**
1. 「(b) 只是待驗證的軟建議」→ 不成立。原文寫「取較嚴的」，且 cluster_spec.json 把它寫成硬驗證條件，14/09/05/01 四份檔一致引用，09 還有素材出處。
2. 「範例只是宣告過了 (a)」→ 不成立。文字是「通過可執行性檢驗」，指涉的是整個第 ③ 步，不是其中一條。
3. 「n 小的時候 (b) 另有放寬條款」→ 全 skill grep 過，沒有任何放寬條文。唯一相關的是 00_通則:486「M6 分群…顧客數 ≥ 50」，但那是「能不能做分群」的入場門檻，不是可執行性檢驗的替代（順帶一提，n≥50 與每群≥30 在 k=4 下本身也有張力，但那是另一個問題，不影響本判定）。

**嚴重度：維持 important**
理由不是「文件筆誤」，而是三點疊加：(i) §5.4 的定位就是「k 的理由要寫成什麼樣」，是給人整段複製的示範，而它示範的正是同節上方 30 行剛禁止的事；(ii) 它與本 skill 出貨的機器驗證規格 `cluster_spec.json` 直接衝突，照抄會驗不過；(iii) 它誘發的失效模式，正好就是 §5.3 花整段引包子期末報告論證的那個後果——小群產不出任何帶統計依據的行動（5 人那群 F 值整格填 `—`、決策建議從 3 條降為 2 條）。17 人在群間比較上一樣沒有檢定力。不到 critical，因為規則本身在正上方寫對了、其他四份檔口徑一致、且 cluster_spec.json 這道機器閘門會補接，harm 是有界的。

**修法我的意見**：對方兩個選項都可行，但我建議走「改數字」而非「寫放寬條款」——n=150、k=4 要同時滿足兩條，最小群需 ≥ 30（=20%），改成例如 34 人（22.7%）即可；同時 `sensitivity` 那句的 19.3% 也要一併改（29 人同樣不合格），否則只修一半。另外建議順手補 07:641 的維護表——該列目前只寫「5% 最小群」，沒提 30 人門檻，這正是這個錯誤能長出來的根。

problem: 00 §四（00:445）規定「無樣本」用半形連字號 `-`，19 §5.3（19:509）還明文說「通用規範建議缺值統一用 em dash `—`，包子用 `N/A` / `-` 兩符號」。07/08/09/14 卻用 em dash `—`，且 09 是在宣稱「沿用 00 §四」的同一句話裡把符號改掉了。這不是排版偏好：00 §四的機械化檢查是字面比對（"'-' 只出現在樣本數欄為 0 或缺席的列"、"'0' 不得出現在樣本數為 0 的格（該用 '-'）"），照 07/09/14 產出的表全部會被 verify_outputs.py 判成不合法。
fix: 全庫統一成 `-`（19 §5.3 已把理由寫清楚，且 00 是地基）。改 07:618、07:627、08:340、09:7、14:417，並在 00 §七維護條款加一列「空值符號改動要同步 6 份檔案」。

verdict.reasoning:
Independently verified by codepoint audit. 00_通則與紀律.md:445 (§四, the authoritative table) defines `-` U+002D for 無樣本, and its machine-check spec at 00:466-467 does literal string comparison ("'-' 只出現在樣本數欄為 0 或缺席的列", "'0' 不得出現在樣本數為 0 的格（該用 '-'）"). 19:484 (§5.2) uses U+002D, 19:509 (§5.3) explicitly records that the general convention is em dash `—` but 包子 uses `N/A` / `-`, and 20:298 implements the Excel numfmt as `"-"` U+002D. Meanwhile 09:7 uses `—` U+2014 inside the very clause that says "空值符號沿用 00_通則與紀律.md §四". Confirmed self-contradiction.

Decisive evidence this is not typographic preference: 19:484 and 14:417/07:500 give the SAME concrete example (狂刷豹 5 人的年齡與地區 F 值) with different characters, so an executing agent cannot determine what to write in that cell.

Two corrections to the reporter, neither of which falsifies the finding:
(1) SCOPE is materially wrong — under-counted roughly 4x. Repo-wide scan of backtick-quoted dash symbols found `—` used for 無樣本 at 07:285, 07:500, 07:627, 08:340, 09:7, 09:276, 09:383, 10:9, 10:466, 10:499, 11:15, 11:159, 11:326, 11:652, 12:524, 13:9, 13:418, 14:178, 14:194, 14:283 (x2), 14:288, 14:417, 14:486, 16:512, and templates/群命名體例.md:117. The reporter's 5-site patch would leave ~20 sites inconsistent, and their proposed 00 §七 clause ("同步 6 份檔案") should read 11 files plus a template.
(2) The reporter OVERSTATES present breakage — verify_outputs.py does not exist in scripts/ (only anonymize_pii.py, db.py, paths.py, setup_check.py); it is a spec distributed across references. Nothing currently fails; the failure is prospective. Also, the repo already self-flags this at 20:288 ("符號口徑待對齊…兩者指同一件事，但字元不同會讓 verify_outputs.py 的字串比對漏檢 —— 交付前確認以 00 §四為準並統一"), though that note itself under-scopes the issue to 14 §九 alone.

I also disagree with the recommended fix DIRECTION as stated. 07:285/07:500 attribute the em dash to the actual empirical source material (gdrive/own/01_包子自己的報告與作業.md §7.4, "包子自己的報告已經有正確示範…整格填 `—`"), and ~25 of ~30 sites use `—`. Both 00:450's and 19:509's stated rationales argue for TWO distinct symbols, not for the hyphen character specifically, so they hold equally under `—` + `N/A`. Unifying on `—` and amending 00/19/20 is cheaper and more source-faithful. This is a fix-choice quibble, not grounds to reject.

Severity: important, agreeing with the reporter but on narrower grounds. It corrupts no number, method, or business decision — the three-way semantic distinction (無樣本 / 算不出來 / 真的是零) is preserved everywhere, and the collision 00:450 actually warns about (dash vs n.s.) is honored in all files, so a human reader is not misled. But the skill's core claim is "口徑只有一個真相" enforced by a literal-string gate, it is designed to be executed by an agent that will not apply the charitable reading, and 09:7 breaks the rule in the same sentence that invokes it. Instructing the agent to emit `—` while the skill's own gate spec admits only `-` is a genuine self-inconsistent instruction set. Borderline with minor given it is a known, direction-decided TODO.

locator: lines 126、128 (§3.1 分群輸入白名單)
quote:
分布通常不極端右偏，課程資料集 R ∈ [8, 401]【實測，出處 17 §八 / `gap-statistical-inference.md` 深挖(2)】
…
極度右偏。課程資料集 M 最大 150,681【實測】
problem: 07 把 17 §八基準表裡三位抽樣客戶的值（R=19/8/401、M=150,681）誤當成母體值域。實際 R ∈ [1, 516]、M 最大 1,153,973。06:473/475 對同一批資料寫的是正確值（m_net_twd max=1,153,973；r_days_since_last_sale min=1, max=516, skew=2.1），兩份直接打架。害處不只是數字錯：07 用錯的值域支撐「R 分布通常不極端右偏 → 原值 z-score 不轉換」的決策，而 06:475 對同一欄的實際處置是「不做 log，改 NTILE(5) 分位分箱」。
how_verified: 從 ntu_creditcard__transactions.parquet 以 as_of=2012-12-01 重算顧客層 R/F/M：R min/max = 1/516（argmin cust 1611、argmax cust 8454），M min/max = 583/1,153,973（argmax cust 13687），M p50 = 76,432.5 —— 與 06 §五的表逐位吻合，連五分位切點 3.0/5.0/22.4/113.8 都一致。另外 09:20 自己引用的客戶 605「R=3 天」（我驗過全對）已經在 07 宣稱的 [8,401] 之外。
fix: 07:126 改「課程資料集 R ∈ [1, 516]、p50=12、skew 2.1（06 §五實測）」，07:128 改「M 最大 1,153,973、p50=76,432」，出處從 17 §八 改成 06 §五（17 §八是三個抽樣客戶的基準值，不是母體分布）。同時重新檢查 R「不轉換」的結論在真實 skew=2.1 下還成不成立。

verdict.reasoning:
I tried to break the claim and could not. Independently recomputed customer-level RFM from 00_source_archive/local/資料集剖析/samples/ntu_creditcard__transactions.parquet (as_of=2012-12-01, 100 customers, 7,764 rows): R min=1 (cust 1611) / p50=12 / max=516 (cust 8454) / mean=73.8 / std=129.45 / skew=2.090; M min=583 / p50=76,432.5 / max=1,153,973 (cust 13687); R quintile cutpoints 3.0/5.0/22.4/113.8. These match 06_前處理與轉換.md:473/475 to the digit and match the source material table in marketing_datasets_profile.md:775-792.

07_標籤與分群.md:126 asserts "課程資料集 R ∈ [8, 401]" and :128 asserts "M 最大 150,681", both tagged 【實測】. Neither is a population value. I traced them: they are exactly the min/max across the three ground-truth CHECK CUSTOMERS listed in 17_指標公式庫.md:246-248 (cust 89 R=19/M=150,681; cust 106 R=8; cust 131 R=401), which I reproduced exactly from the parquet. 17 §八 is titled 驗證基準值 (per-customer ground truth checklist) and cannot support a value range, so the citation "出處 17 §八" is a misread. The upstream origin of the error is research/gap-statistical-inference.md:148, which itself derives the range from those same checkpoint customers.

The error is load-bearing, not cosmetic. 07:126 uses "分布通常不極端右偏" to prescribe R as 原值 z-score with no transform. But (a) the real skew is 2.09; (b) 07 §3.3 Step 1 in the SAME file mandates "skew > 1 的欄套 log1p", so the whitelist row contradicts the executable rule 33 lines below it; (c) 04_資料體檢.md:477 says "R 極度右偏"; (d) 06:475 prescribes NTILE(5) quantile binning for the same column and explicitly rejects raw treatment because equal-width binning puts 90% in the first bin; (e) the source material's own 評註 (marketing_datasets_profile.md:794) says "R 的分布極度右偏". Additionally 09_行銷_顧客價值.md:20 cites customer 605 with R=3 (I verified R=3), already outside the asserted [8,401]. So a reader following 07 and a reader following 04/06 get opposite preprocessing for the same column.

Consequence if followed: raw z-scored R into Euclidean K-Means, where R=516 sits at z=+3.42 while the median customer sits at z=-0.48 — the exact single-variable-dominates-WGSS failure that 07 §3.3 spends a whole section warning about for M. scripts/prep_cluster_matrix.py does not exist in scripts/ (only anonymize_pii/db/paths/setup_check), so there is no implemented code path that auto-corrects the prose.

Severity: I agree with "important", not critical. Mitigating: 07 §3.3 Step 3 (>70% WGSS contribution → warning) and Step 4 (pre/post-standardization ARI) would surface a dominating R at runtime, and the correct figures live in 04:477 and 06:473/475, so the defect is discoverable rather than silently corrupting a deliverable. Aggravating beyond the original report: the same stale figures also appear at 06_前處理與轉換.md:93 ("R ∈ [8, 401]、F ∈ [16, 85]、M ∈ [約 2 萬, 150,681]"), contradicting 06:473/475 within one file — there it only makes a scale-ratio argument conservative rather than flipping a decision, but it should be fixed in the same pass. Recommended fix matches the reporter's: 07:126 → "R ∈ [1, 516]、p50=12、skew 2.1", 07:128 → "M 最大 1,153,973、p50=76,432", re-cite to 06 §五 / marketing_datasets_profile.md RFM 分位表 instead of 17 §八, and re-derive the "原值 z-score / 不轉換" decision under the true skew=2.09 (06:475's answer for this column is NTILE(5), not log).

verdict.reasoning:
Confirmed by reading both files. 19:58 (§1.4 M6) lists 8 figures ending in 群大小水平長條 and contains no HDBSCAN figure anywhere in the file (grep confirms zero hits for HDBSCAN in 19). 07:603-614 lists 8 required figures whose #8 is M6_kmeans_hdbscan_heatmap.png and demotes 群大小水平長條 (M6_size_barh.png) to "建議一併出". Both totals are 8, the sets differ by one swap, and 07:599 explicitly says "規格見 19 §1.4" while 07:601 quotes REQUIRED_FIGURES["M6"] = 8 — 07 cites 19 as authority then substitutes an element. The citation loop runs both ways: 07:336 sources the ARI 0.6 threshold to "19 §1.4".

An analyst following 19 alone omits the visual evidence for the guard against fabricated clusters; an analyst following 07 alone omits the group-size chart that 19 marks 預設必出 (and which is the §5.3 executability check evidence, plus where 07:354 requires the noise group to remain visible). quote:
SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type IN ('sale','return','exchange_in','exchange_out')
             THEN amount_twd ELSE 0 END)                                   AS m_net_twd
problem: 同一節的數學式寫 M_net = Σsale − Σ|return| + (Σexchange_in − Σ|exchange_out|)，SQL 卻是四種 txn_type 直接相加。兩者只有在「退貨列的 amount_twd 一律存負值」時才等價，但 DDL（L235 amount_twd DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL）、§五的語意表（L548–554 只寫「減」「抵銷」）以及全 references（grep exchange_out 全庫只有 4 個命中）都沒有任何一句宣告這個符號約定。POS 匯出「金額為正 + txn_type 旗標」是常見形式，而 §八 L697 又說超市檔是「43 筆為負＝退貨」，兩種形式在同一份文件裡都出現過。m_return_twd 這欄同樣受害：存負值時它會是負數，欄名卻叫退貨金額。
how_verified: 在 DuckDB 1.5.5 建同欄位表，插入 ('p1','sale',1000) 與 ('p1','return',300)（退貨存正值）後實跑 §五 那段 SQL，得到 m_net_twd = 1300；數學式的正解是 1000 − |300| = 700，虛胖 86%，且完全不報錯。
fix: 在 3.3 的 fact_transaction DDL 明寫符號約定並加 CHECK（return/exchange_out 一律 <= 0）；同時把 SQL 改成不依賴符號、與數學式一字對應：sale/exchange_in 取 +ABS(amount_twd)、return/exchange_out 取 −ABS(amount_twd)，m_return_twd 用 SUM(ABS(...))。並同步寫進 dim_metric_definition 與 references/17 §二（02 §九 第 4 條本來就要求兩份同步）。

verdict.reasoning:
Confirmed by independent reading and execution. L556 states M_net = Σsale − Σ|return| + (Σexchange_in − Σ|exchange_out|), written sign-agnostically with absolute values, while L571-580 computes m_net_twd as a raw SUM over four txn_types. These agree only if return/exchange_out rows carry negative amount_twd, and that convention is declared nowhere: L235 DDL is a bare `amount_twd DECIMAL(18,4) NOT NULL` with no comment; `grep "CHECK("` across all of skill/ returns zero hits; the L548-554 semantics table says 加/減/抵銷 (magnitude language, leaning against signed storage); 06_前處理與轉換.md has no sign-normalization step. The only near-declaration is 17_指標公式庫.md:285, a dirty-fixture description (負金額 + txn_type='return'), which is a test-data note in a different file, not a model rule. Meanwhile 02 §八 L697/L725 shows the real sources are the opposite shape: the only dataset with returns (超市) stores negatives but has no txn_type column at all, and the credit-card file is 無負無零.

I reproduced it in DuckDB 1.5.5 with the same DDL types. With return stored +300 against sale 1000: m_gross=1000, m_return=300, m_net=1300, versus the formula's 700 — silently inflated, no error. With return stored −300: m_net=700 (correct) but m_return_twd=−300, i.e. a column named 退貨金額 holding a negative, and m_gross − m_return = 1300 ≠ m_net, so the advertised 三欄對照 does not reconcile. Under either convention at least one of the three columns contradicts its own name or the formula printed two lines above it. This is a genuine internal inconsistency, not a reader's misreading. Supporting evidence in the same block: the semantics table says void 抵銷（原列一併排除）, yet the SQL neither excludes void nor removes the voided original from m_gross_twd.

Severity corrected from critical to important. This is a documentation/skill repo and grep for m_net across *.py and *.sql shows no executable code implements this pattern — it appears exactly once as an illustration. The primary RFM path (02 L566-569 v_txn_for_rfm, 17 §二 L39-50, 03 L367-389) all filter txn_type='sale', so the sign convention cannot affect those numbers. The correct formula is printed immediately above the wrong SQL. It remains important rather than minor because 17 L37 instructs users to ship the gross/net 對照 as a deliverable, the failure is exactly the silent 18-G2 class the document exists to prevent, and the root cause — the core fact table never declaring the sign semantics of its amount column — propagates ambiguity to every 淨額 computation built on this model. The proposed fix (declare the convention plus a CHECK in the 3.3 DDL, rewrite the SQL sign-agnostically with +ABS/−ABS and SUM(ABS(...)) for m_return_twd, and sync to dim_metric_definition and references/17 §二 per 02 §九 L755) is correct.

file: skill/行銷數據分析/references/06_前處理與轉換.md
locator: L542–550（view stg_transaction_twd）；關鍵行 L543、L544
quote:
SELECT t.*,
       t.amount * COALESCE(fx.rate, 1.0) AS amount_twd,
       CASE WHEN t.currency <> 'TWD' AND fx.rate IS NULL
            THEN 'ERROR: fx rate missing' END AS fx_flag   -- 缺匯率要擋，不可靜默補 1.0
problem: 兩個獨立的靜默錯誤。(1) 註解說「不可靜默補 1.0」，程式碼寫的正是 COALESCE(fx.rate, 1.0)：缺匯率時 amount_twd = amount × 1.0，把 USD 3,200 當 NT$3,200，正是 02 §一 L5 用來論證 dim_fx_rate 必要性的「ROAS 從 1.18 算成 37.5」案例；fx_flag 只是旁邊多一欄，不會擋住任何下游查詢。(2) SELECT t.* 已經帶出 fact_transaction.amount_twd（02 DDL L235），再 alias 一個同名欄，DuckDB 不報錯而是把新算的那欄自動改名成 amount_twd_1，下游 SELECT amount_twd 拿到的是原始未換匯的欄。
how_verified: 用 02 §三的 DDL 在 DuckDB 1.5.5 建表後建立同結構的 view，DESCRIBE 實測輸出欄位為 ['amount_twd', 'amount_twd_1']；COALESCE 的行為直接由 SQL 語義得出。
fix: 改成 SELECT t.* EXCLUDE (amount_twd), t.line_amount_net * fx.rate_to_twd AS amount_twd, (t.currency <> 'TWD' AND fx.rate_to_twd IS NULL) AS fx_missing —— 不 COALESCE，缺就是 NULL；另在 sql/checks/ 加一條 SELECT count(*) FROM stg_transaction_twd WHERE fx_missing，非 0 即 error。「擋」要靠 check SQL，不能靠一個沒人讀的欄位。

verdict.reasoning: Independently reproduced. Read 02_資料模型規格.md L210-248: fact_transaction has no `amount` column (only unit_price / line_amount_gross / discount_amount / line_amount_net / amount_twd) and no `txn_date` column (only event_ts_utc / event_ts_local / biz_date). Built that exact DDL plus dim_fx_rate in DuckDB 1.5.5 and ran the view from 06 L542-550 verbatim: BinderException "Table \"t\" does not have a column named \"txn_date\"" (candidates: txn_id, txn_type); isolating the other column gives "does not have a column named \"amount\"" (candidate: amount_twd). The reporter's substitution binds cleanly. Tried to break the claim: the strongest defense is that the snippet is generic illustration rather than bound to 02's model, but that fails — L530's comment explicitly anchors dim_fx_rate to "02_資料模型規格.md 的維度表，M3 之前必須建好", L547 names fact_transaction, and 02 holds the only definition of that table in the repo, with no pseudocode disclaimer in §7.1. Severity kept at important rather than raised or lowered. Aggravating: L550 picks the FX rate by joining on a date column, which is exactly what 02 §四 L498 forbids ("biz_date 是唯一允許 join dim_date 的欄", reinforced at L513 "join 其他欄一律視為 bug"), and 02 already supplies fact_transaction.fx_rate_date for this purpose — so the skill contradicts its own hard rule; the block is normative ("M3 之前必須建好") and §7.3's gate at L581 queries the resulting stg_transaction_twd view. Mitigating against critical: it fails loudly at bind time, so it cannot silently produce wrong business numbers as written. Two corrections to the report: (1) the fix is incomplete — the same vocabulary mismatch (txn_date / amount / cust_id against fact_transaction) recurs in 17_指標公式庫.md L43-50, so the skill has a systemic split between 02's canonical schema and the teaching SQL in 06/17; patching only 06 leaves 17 equally non-executable. (2) The proposed fix introduces a defect the reporter missed: 02 L235 declares amount_twd as a stored NOT NULL column on fact_transaction (FX conversion already happened upstream), so `SELECT t.*, ... AS amount_twd` emits amount_twd twice; I confirmed DuckDB collapses this to one column instead of erroring, silently resolving to one of the two values. A correct fix needs `t.* EXCLUDE (amount_twd)` or a distinct alias, and should reconsider why a view downstream of fact_transaction is recomputing a column the fact table already stores.

FROM fact_transaction

problem: 同一張交易表在三份文件裡有三套名字：02 DDL 建的是 fact_transaction（person_key / biz_date / amount_twd）；03 §三 L204 的命名規約規定 mart 事實表前綴是 fct_，其 feat_rfm.sql 讀 fct_transaction（customer_id）；17 讀 fact_transaction 但欄位是 cust_id / txn_date / amount。02 §九 L755 明寫「17 的口徑改了要檢查 §五的 v_txn_for_rfm…不同步就是靜默錯誤」，但同步只做了 txn_type='sale' 過濾，沒做欄名與表名。

verdict.reasoning:
Independently verified by reading the files; the claim holds and is understated in one respect.

CONFIRMED FACTS:
- references/17_指標公式庫.md L40-50: feat_rfm reads `FROM fact_transaction` selecting `cust_id`, `txn_date`, `SUM(amount)`.
- references/02_資料模型規格.md L210-248 (the authoritative DDL) defines `fact_transaction` with `customer_key BIGINT` / `person_key VARCHAR`, `biz_date DATE`, `amount_twd DECIMAL(18,4)`. `cust_id`, `txn_date`, `amount` exist on no version of that table.
- references/03_倉儲與檔案結構.md L204 mandates `fct_` for mart facts (example `fct_transaction`), and its 完整範本 at L358-389 reads `fct_transaction` with `customer_id` / `biz_date` / `amount_twd`. `fct_transaction` appears nowhere in 02's DDL.
- 02 §九 L755 does obligate 17<->02 sync and flags drift as 靜默錯誤; only the `txn_type='sale'` filter was synced (02 §五 L564-581 uses `fact_transaction`/`biz_date`/`person_key`), not the table or column names.

EVIDENCE THE CLAIMANT DID NOT CITE, which supports the finding:
- The package's only shipped executable SQL (templates/sql/cac_payback.sql, templates/sql/growth_decomp.sql) uses `fact_transaction` + `person_key` + `biz_date` + `amount_twd`, matching 02 exactly. So the proposed fix is already what the runnable artifacts do; 03 and 17 are the deviants.
- 00_通則與紀律.md L55 shows `03_mart/fact_transaction.parquet`, contradicting 03 L204's `fct_` rule from outside 03.
- 17's header declares scripts/build_features.py the authoritative implementation, verified by tests/test_metrics.py. NEITHER EXISTS (scripts/ holds only anonymize_pii.py, db.py, paths.py, setup_check.py; there is no tests/ dir). These SQL blocks therefore ARE the spec — the "docs are merely illustrative, the code is correct" defense is unavailable.
- 17 also violates naming rules 03 itself states: 03 L234 "顧客單位一律 customer_id", L235 "金額欄一律帶幣別後綴".
- Worse than claimed: the key is a four-way split, not two-way. 02's DDL carries BOTH `customer_key` and `person_key` (02 §五 L573/L580 groups RFM by `person_key`); 03 L322 uses `customer_key` in a file header but `customer_id` at L371/378; 04_資料體檢.md L124 declares `customer_id` mandatory.

DEFENSES TESTED AND REJECTED:
- No pseudo-code/illustrative disclaimer anywhere in 17 (grepped for 示意/概念/僅示範/不是可執行).
- Layer-difference defense fails: 17 selects `txn_type`, which per 02's DDL exists only on the mart fact table, and staging tables carry the `stg_` prefix per 03 L203. So 17 genuinely intends 02's table, not a staging variant.

SEVERITY — held at important, not escalated to critical: the failure mode is loud (Binder/Catalog error on first execution), not the silent-wrong-number class this skill exists to prevent, and the fix is mechanical. But it is not a typo: three mutually incompatible schemas for the central fact table across the three most-cited foundational references, in a package whose stated value proposition is 單一真相 and 每個數字都要能追回它的計算過程, and whose own §九 maintenance clause names this exact drift hazard and then fails to honor it. A reader cannot determine which naming is authoritative. Should be fixed before the repo is pushed to GitHub.

【1】中文欄名違規 — 確認。我依 02_資料模型規格.md L210–247 的 DDL 實建 fact_transaction，把 L188–207 原文照跑（DuckDB 1.5.5），得 BinderException: Referenced column "客戶ID" not found in FROM clause!。違反的不只一條規則：02 §3.1 L151「表名欄名 全小寫 snake_case ASCII，禁止中文」，以及 03_倉儲與檔案結構.md §3.3 L214「中文欄名不准進 staging」，後者 L232–239 還附了正好涵蓋這些欄的映射表（客戶ID→customer_id、刷卡日期→txn_date、刷卡產品產業分類→category_l1）。00_通則 L40 的「原始檔原名不動」只適用 01_raw/，這段查的是 fact_transaction，不適用。

【2】這是整套 references 唯一一處中文欄名 SQL。其他查同表的區塊（17 L47 cust_id/txn_date/amount、06 L547 t.txn_date、02 L567/578/623）全是 ASCII snake_case。附帶一提，那些也沒完全照 DDL 欄名，所以「欄名對不上 DDL」單獨看是全檔案共通的鬆散慣例，這點稍微削弱對方的論述；但「品類」性質不同——fact_transaction 全表沒有任何品類欄，品類在 dim_product.category_l2_code/_name（L255），這是缺一個 join，不是簡寫。

【3】tie-break 不確定性 — 我實測確認，而且這是危害較大的一半。SELECT DISTINCT 客戶ID, 交易日期, 品類 刻意保留同日多品類，LEAD ... ORDER BY 交易日期 就是在有系統性 ties 的欄上排序。用合成資料（400 顧客、每日 1–3 品類），只改 PRAGMA threads 與實體插入順序，同一份資料兩次跑出的轉移矩陣有 97/100 格不同；把 ORDER BY 補成 (biz_date, cat) 後三次跑全部一致。同日多品類在本領域是常態不是邊緣情況——本檔 §1.0 自己記載超市每單 3.82 個中類。

【4】對方沒抓到的第四點：註解 ① 寫「去重到「顧客-日」」，但 DISTINCT(客戶ID, 交易日期, 品類) 根本不是顧客-日去重；§4.2 L180 自己把真值定義為 drop_duplicates(['客戶ID','刷卡日期']) = 5,294 列。程式碼與自己的註解互相矛盾，而 ties 正是從這裡進來的。

【5】L210–215 的四條診斷訊號一條都攔不到：不可重現的矩陣照樣列加總=1、沒有對角線霸榜、沒有哨兵值。

嚴重度維持 important（與對方一致）。這是 reference 文件不是生產程式；欄名那半在第一次執行就大聲失敗、修起來很便宜。但 tie-break 那半是靜默的，會改動這一節存在的唯一產出（Top-N P(B|A) 排序 → 不同的推播名單），違反 skill 核心原則「每個數字都要能追回它的計算過程」與 00 §1.3 雙路徑驗算，而且能繞過文件自備的所有防呆。不到 critical：不會自動流進已交付的產物，且欄名錯誤會讓人在第一次執行就停下來。

建議修法（對方的方向正確，我補一項）：改為 fact_transaction JOIN dim_product 取 category_l2_code AS cat、鍵用 person_key、日期用 biz_date；LEAD 的 ORDER BY 補成 (biz_date, cat)；另外要一併修正註解 ①，明確寫出「同日多品類保留全部並以 cat 為 tie-break（此排序是約定而非真實時序）」，否則註解與程式碼的矛盾還在。

file: skill/行銷數據分析/references/02_資料模型規格.md
locator: L322+L334（fact_marketing_spend.creative_key）、L394+L399（fact_store_traffic.zone_id）、L445+L448（dim_channel_mapping.raw_campaign_pattern）
quote:
creative_key      BIGINT,
    ...
    PRIMARY KEY (platform, account_id, campaign_key, creative_key, report_date, data_as_of_date)
problem: 三欄都刻意宣告成可為 NULL（dim_creative 是選配、zone_id 是動線熱圖才有的店內感測、raw_campaign_pattern 是選配 pattern），但 DuckDB 對 PRIMARY KEY 欄一律隱含 NOT NULL。結果是最常見的情況（活動層級 spend 無素材拆分、沒有區域感測器的門市、不需 campaign pattern 的通路對照）根本插不進去。
how_verified: 用 02 §三的 DDL 在 DuckDB 1.5.5 建表（19 張全部建立成功），再插入含 NULL 的一列，三張表分別回 ConstraintException: NOT NULL constraint failed: fact_marketing_spend.creative_key / fact_store_traffic.zone_id / dim_channel_mapping.raw_campaign_pattern。
fix: 三個 PK 欄各給哨兵預設值並標 NOT NULL，把「無此維度」顯式化：creative_key BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0、zone_id VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT '_ALL'、raw_campaign_pattern VARCHAR NOT NULL DEFAULT '*'。不要改成 UNIQUE 索引（NULL 彼此不相等會放進重複列）。

verdict.reasoning:
Confirmed by my own reproduction on DuckDB 1.5.5 (the version pinned in the doc's §三 header, L140 "完整 DDL（DuckDB 1.5.5）"). Creating fact_marketing_spend verbatim from L318-335 yields information_schema is_nullable='NO' for creative_key even though the DDL declares no NOT NULL — DuckDB implicitly promotes all PK members. Inserting NULL reproduces ConstraintException: NOT NULL constraint failed on fact_marketing_spend.creative_key, fact_store_traffic.zone_id, and dim_channel_mapping.raw_campaign_pattern.

I tried three ways to refute it, all fail:
(1) "PK implies NOT NULL in standard SQL, so the missing NOT NULL is mere redundancy-avoidance" — refuted by the file's own consistency: every other PK-member column carries an explicit NOT NULL (platform, account_id, campaign_key, report_date, data_as_of_date in the same table; store_key/biz_date/hour_slot; raw_source/raw_medium/valid_from; plus map_identity L192-201, dim_metric_definition L424-433, dim_fx_rate L437-440). Omission on exactly these three is deliberate intent that they be nullable, not house style.
(2) "It's prose, not runnable DDL" — the header explicitly labels it complete DuckDB 1.5.5 DDL, CLAUDE.md calls this file 所有分析的地基, and all 19 tables do create successfully.
(3) "Maybe all rows really have these values" — the doc contradicts itself. L394 passersby_cnt (店前人潮) is a storefront measure with no per-zone meaning, so zone-less rows are clearly intended; and L105 declares the fact_marketing_spend grain as 平台×帳戶×活動×report_date×data_as_of_date, which omits creative entirely, yet creative_key sits in the PK.

I also verified the claimant's stated rationale for rejecting UNIQUE: UNIQUE(a,b) with b IS NULL accepted two identical rows (count=2) in DuckDB 1.5.5. One gap in their fix they did not state: NOT NULL DEFAULT only helps when the column is omitted from the INSERT column list; an explicit NULL still raises, so positional-VALUES loaders still fail.

Severity: important, matching the claim, but on different grounds. The failure itself is loud and one-line-fixable, which argues against critical — nothing produces wrong numbers from the doc as written. What earns important is the mis-repair path: the two obvious workarounds (drop the column from the PK, or switch to UNIQUE) both destroy the dedup guarantee on a table whose L325 comment says 回填是規格不是 bug, so re-pulled data_as_of_date snapshots would then silently double-count spend. Two caveats for the fixer: because L105 declares a campaign-level grain, the correct repair for creative_key may be removing it from the PK rather than sentinel-defaulting it; and any sentinel adopted must be registered, since 04_資料體檢.md Q2 puts sentinel values at error severity with a candidate set that includes 0.

Provenance note: 00_source_archive/audit/audit-code.md L270-295 holds the same claim verbatim, but that is the claimant's own untracked writeup, not independent corroboration. My conclusion rests only on the DuckDB runs.

CLAUDE.md advertises 「新機器第一件事：python scripts/setup_check.py」 with exit 0 = 全通過, so a fresh machine reports all-clear and the failure surfaces only mid-analysis.

SUM(t.amount_twd)          FILTER (WHERE t.biz_date BETWEEN :a_start AND :a_end) AS r_a,

problem: 兩件事。(1) DuckDB 具名參數是 $name 不是 :name，兩支檔案連 parse 都過不了。(2) 02 §3.2 的 dim_customer 沒有 first_purchase_date，也沒有 cac_payback.sql 用的 acquisition_channel_key。

verdict.reasoning:
I independently reproduced both defects and could not rebut either.

DEFECT 1 — parameter syntax. Ran duckdb 1.5.5 extract_statements on the unmodified growth_decomp.sql: "Parser Error: syntax error at or near \":\"". Converting :x -> $x parses clean. I specifically looked for a translation layer that could make :name legal and there is none: the project's own execution path is scripts/db.py:115, `con.execute(sql, params)` on a raw duckdb connection — no SQLAlchemy, no pandas read_sql. DuckDB is unambiguously the target engine (03_倉儲與檔案結構.md §7.1 db.py template, .duckdb warehouse, DATE_DIFF and ASOF JOIN elsewhere). :name is SQLAlchemy/Oracle style, valid in neither DuckDB nor Postgres. Scope is actually LARGER than the reporter said: references/11_行銷_成長與促銷.md:80-81 teaches the same broken :b_start/:a_start inline, so the wrong pattern is in the reference too.

DEFECT 2 — missing columns. The dim_customer DDL at references/02_資料模型規格.md:157-189 contains neither first_purchase_date nor acquisition_channel_key. Grep across the entire skill directory: first_purchase_date appears only in the two templates and reference 11; acquisition_channel_key appears only in cac_payback.sql:11. Binding the dollar-converted SQL against the real §3.2 DDL yields "Binder Error: Table \"c\" does not have a column named \"first_purchase_date\"" for BOTH files. registered_date is not a silent substitute — 02 labels it "登記日期（tenure/cohort 唯一來源）" while 11 §1.3 explicitly requires the first-PURCHASE date and warns against both registration-based and earliest-row proxies (18-G3). Genuine spec hole, not a rename.

MATH — I confirmed the reporter's claim that the logic is sound, so the fix must not touch it. With synthetic data (period A: 2 txns/200, period B: 1 txn/300) the query returned eff_freq=-100, eff_ticket=400, eff_interaction=-200, summing to exactly 100 = delta_r, matching my hand-computed p_A*df + f_A*dp + df*dp.

SEVERITY — agree with important; not critical. These are the only two SQL templates in the skill and reference 11 §1.5 advertises them as "完整可執行版" (complete executable version), yet both are 100% non-runnable: they die at parse, and after fixing parse they die at bind. Two independent fatal defects plus a cross-file contradiction between 02 (which CLAUDE.md calls "所有分析的地基") and 11/templates. It falls short of critical only because both failures are loud — no silently wrong numbers, and the decomposition arithmetic is verified correct. It is clearly above minor because the missing column is not a one-token edit: it requires a real decision (materialize first_purchase_date as a Type 1 derived column recomputed from fact_transaction, carrying the 18-G3 left-truncation caveat, vs. rewriting both templates with a self-contained first-purchase CTE — the latter avoiding the truncation trap but conflicting with 11 §1.3's instruction to use the dimension's first-purchase date).

1) Normal, equal means, n=150/100/47, SD ratio 3.376 (variance ratio 11.4×, matching the doc's own example): ANOVA α=0.223, Welch α=0.051, KW α=0.116. With n=200/60/40, SD 1/2/3.376: ANOVA 0.251, Welch 0.051, KW 0.142. Reversed pairing (n=47/100/150): ANOVA 0.017, Welch 0.050, KW 0.035. Welch holds nominal α exactly under the triggering condition; KW inflates 2.3–2.8×. The table therefore steps away from the only method that solves the stated problem — confirmed, not just asserted.
2) The "只能主張中位數排序" license: lognormal groups with IDENTICAL medians (all = 1), σ = 0.5/0.5/1.2, n=150/100/47 → KW rejects 10.0% at α=0.05. Rejection is driven purely by dispersion. At a variance ratio of 11.4× the equal-shape condition cannot hold, so the median-ordering interpretation is invalid. Log-transform + Welch on the same data gives α=0.051, i.e. the row's first-listed remedy (轉換) is the correct one.

REFUTATIONS ATTEMPTED AND REJECTED:
(a) "05's 轉換 option rescues row 4" — true for 05, but 07:511 offers only KW, and 00:237 / 08:435 record KW as 實際採用 in the worked example.
(b) "KW is a legitimate assumption-reduction step" — it drops normality but ADDS an equal-shape requirement that Welch does not need, so it is a lateral swap, not a step down; this violates 00 §1.6's own rule "只准往前提更少的方向退一格".
(c) "Welch may be untrustworthy at n=47 with 11.4× variance" — simulation says otherwise (α=0.051).

1. 07 §3.1 line 131 確有「| `CRI` | 原值 z-score | 同上，收縮量指標 |」；line 134「明確禁止：性別、年齡、婚姻、地區…」（對方標為 §3.2，實際是 §3.1 末，無關緊要）。
2. templates/cluster_spec.json 的預設 input_vars 就含 "cri"，所以這是預設路徑而非邊緣案例。
3. 09 §2.1 line 85 的恆等式 CRI ≡ W2×100、W2=(s_i²/n_i)/(τ_g²+s_i²/n_i)；line 93 明文裁定「人口變數可以當先驗分群，但不可以當 k-means 輸入…兩者是不同的事」。
4. 我追到素材原檔 00_source_archive/gdrive/own/02_包子自己的計算檔逐步拆解.md:735-745：先驗群確實是 男/女 × 北/中/南/東/外島，τ²₄(男,東區)=36,698,958.83、τ²₅(男,外島)=2,642,304.35；Step 4 的 E 欄 VLOOKUP 分群、G 欄 VLOOKUP 分群變異數。人口鍵值確實進入每人 CRI。
5. 對方算式我重算：s_i²/n_i=1e7 時 W2=0.2141(群4) vs 0.7910(群5)，比值 3.69。正確。
6. 我另外做了獨立交叉驗證：客戶 62 n=18、s_i²=311,646.89 → s_i²/n_i=17,313.7，配 τ²=15,251,216（女,北區）得 W2=0.0011339，與 09 §2.1 引的實測 I2=0.0011339478248075215 吻合到 7 位。公式與人口鍵值皆為真。

【推翻不掉的核心】
CRI 在數學上不是純行為量：它是 f(個人統計量, 所屬人口群 τ_g²)。交易紀錄完全相同的兩人僅因性別×地區不同即得不同 CRI。因此 09 §2.1「兩者是不同的事」這句裁定就其字面而言為假——先驗群確實透過 CRI 進了下游。07 §3.1 允許 CRI 進分群、同頁 §3.2 以教材 P26「行為本質非成員結構」為據禁止人口變數，兩者相互矛盾。§8.2 的 gate 是變數名集合交集（set(cluster_input_vars) & set(anova_tested_vars)），結構上看不到衍生血緣，確實攔不到；且 scripts/ 底下根本還沒有 verify_outputs.py。

- 「§8.4 卡方必然顯著」不成立。實資料中 s_i²/n_i ≪ τ_g²（客戶 62 是 17k vs 15M），故 W2 ≈ (s_i²/n_i)/τ_g²，取對數後人口項只是一個至多 log(14) 的加性平移（τ_g² 全距 2.64M–36.7M），而個人項跨客戶至少橫跨兩個數量級以上（客戶 62 → 17k、客戶 87 由 I3=0.0972 反推 → 約 2.7M）。對方固定 s_i²/n_i 的 3.7 倍示範只證明了「依賴性」，不是「實際污染量」，他也沒嘗試估計後者。
- 07 §3.1 是「原值 z-score」而非 log。原值 CRI 在 0.001–1 之間極度右偏，z-score 後該軸的 k-means 幾何被少數高 CRI 客戶主導，而他們高是因為 s_i²/n_i 巨大、不是因為群別。這進一步稀釋了「分群會變成人口分群 → 卡方必然顯著」的因果鏈。
- 文件並非毫無察覺：09 §2.1 已把它標為「18-E2 的邊界」並要求先驗分群寫進參數表。缺陷是「裁定不完整/表述有誤」，不是「危害未被標示」。

【嚴重度】
本 skill 自己標 critical 的是 S1（純噪音也吐 p<0.001 的循環 ANOVA）與 S5（E<1 仍跑卡方）那類「必然得出錯誤推論」的問題。本項是部分污染造成的偏誤，加上一處確實存在的內部矛盾，發生在預設設定上，且出現在一份權威完全建立在這類嚴謹度上的文件裡——夠格 important，但不到 critical。對方提的修法 (b) 或 (c) 方向正確，(c) 是最低限度；把 §8.2 gate 升級成血緣比對亦屬合理但屬加分項。

The "輸出物件裡不得有 p 值欄位" gate is cosmetic against any reader who does the arithmetic.

**The noise test — the document's own falsification argument — applies verbatim to η².** On pure standard-normal noise with no structure, running the identical pipeline: per-variable η² median 0.500 (min 0.157, max 0.765); p < 0.001 in 100% of reps; η² > 0.10 in 100% of reps. So the permitted number is inflated by exactly the mechanism §8.2 exists to condemn, and it lands where a reader will call it strong separation.

**The inconsistency is internal to the section, which is what makes it more than a stylistic quibble.** §8.2's stated reason for banning F is 「F 正是那個被最佳化的量」. η² = BGSS/TSS is a monotone rescaling of that same optimized quantity. You cannot ban a statistic for being the optimization target and then permit a strictly increasing function of it under the label 「效果量」. Sharper still: 16 §8.2's table permits η² in row 1 while row 3 states that the evidence for 「分群是否真實」 must be `structure_pvalue` — the leak is between two rows of the same table. §7.4 of 07 already says the same thing (「這個數字才可以寫進報告當『分群有效性』的依據 → §八的 ANOVA p 值不行」).

L0 partitions are exogenous pre-existing business categories (會員等級/卡別), not learned from the data — η² there is legitimate and non-circular, so it does not prove circular use. But the point survives in a stronger corrected form: the document establishes a calibration for η² (< 0.10 = groups don't separate) on exogenous partitions, then hands the reader η² on learned partitions with no note that the calibration no longer transfers — and my simulation shows pure noise clears that 0.10 threshold 100% of the time once the partition is learned. The 95% CI objection is valid but secondary: it is a post-selection interval on members chosen by their values on that very variable, and non-overlapping CIs get read as a significance claim (compounded by 16 §1.4 mandating the p/effect-size/CI triple as the house format, so CI+η² reads as that triple with one column suppressed). "Ban CI outright" is arguable; relabel-and-annotate is the safer fix.

**Provenance (does not exonerate).** The η² allowance is transcribed verbatim from `E:\Projects\行銷分析\00_source_archive\research\gap-statistical-inference.md` §S1 修補動作 1. The reference is still the authoritative deliverable, so it needs fixing — but the fix deviates from the source and should be re-marked per the project's provenance convention. Also note `verify_outputs.py` does not exist in `scripts/` yet (only anonymize_pii/db/paths/setup_check), so the proposed gate expansion is a documentation change, not a code fix.

**Severity downgraded critical → important.** The rule as written still blocks the entire documented harm path: no ANOVA, no post-hoc, no p column, and 「不寫『顯著』二字」. The 14.5萬 VIP sentence in §8.2 (「極顯著差異 p<0.001，證實分群結果具備統計效力」) cannot be written under the current rule. What remains is a weaker restatement route (「四群解釋 72% 的變異」) that would pass the gate, plus arithmetic recoverability of p — a hole in a mitigation, not the absence of one. And the correct instrument is already specified two sections earlier, so the repair is a column deletion plus a cross-reference, not new methodology. That is materially less severe than the things this project reserves "critical" for (S1 itself, S5 expected-counts), where compliant use produces a wrong six-figure decision with no counter-instruction anywhere in the document.

**Recommended fix (close to the reviewer's, with amendments).** In 07 §8.2, 07 §8.6 and 16 §8.2/§8.4, change the (a)-row 「准做什麼」 to 群均值 / 群內 sd / 群大小 / index（相對全體=100）; add an explicit 「✗ 不得輸出 η²／F／p——η² 與 F 是嚴格單調變換，報 η² 等同報 F」; either drop the 95% CI or keep it explicitly relabeled as a dispersion display with a post-selection caveat; change the mandatory table annotation to 「（分群輸入變數，僅為輪廓描述；分離度證據見 §7.4 的 structure_pvalue）」; and when `verify_outputs.py` is written, make the S1 gate `set(cluster_input_vars) & (anova_tested_vars | eta2_reported_vars) == set()`.

verdict.reasoning:
Verified independently at all three locations; the claim survives.

CONFIRMED FACTS (read from source, not from the reporter's summary):
1. 07 §7.3 line 392 frames the block as 「不過關時的降級階梯（沿用 00 §1.6，往「前提更少」的方向退一格）」, and line 401 is 「▼ ③ 仍不過 → 兩階段（Ward + K-Means）」.
2. 07 §二 lines 72-73 draw L1 K-Means ──► L2 Ward + K-Means (upgrade direction), and line 86's 前提 column states HAC 是 O(n²logn) 時間、O(n²) 空間、「n > 3 萬要先抽樣或改走 L1」. Premise containment is objective: Ward's premises = K-Means's ∪ {n ≤ 數千}.
3. 00 §1.6 line 244 header reads 「階梯（左 → 右 = 前提由多到少）」 and line 251's 分群 row is 「兩階段（Ward + k-means）→ k-means → 分位切割 → 業務規則標籤」. So 00 places 兩階段 at the MOST-premises end — downgrading from 兩階段 lands on k-means. §7.3 ③ runs that arrow in reverse. No misreading by the reporter.

TWO ADDITIONAL PROHIBITIONS the reporter did not cite, which strengthen the finding:
- 00:222 「不是往旁邊換一個等難度的方法（換 LSD 為 SNK 不叫降級）」
- 07:639 — inside the accused file itself — 「階梯只能在「前提由多到少」的軸上插入，**不可平移**（00 §七）」. The file violates its own maintenance clause.

GUARD IS GENUINELY MISSING: grep across the entire references/ tree shows the 「n > 3 萬」 constraint appears exactly once, at 07:86. §7.3 neither restates nor cross-references it.

MEMORY MATH VERIFIED BY COMPUTATION (not accepted on assertion): condensed distance matrix at n=50,000 = 1,249,975,000 float64 pairs = 9.31 GB; at n=30,000 = 3.35 GB (which is precisely why the doc's own 3萬 cutoff sits there). scipy ward linkage requires that resident. The OOM outcome is real.

WHERE I DIVERGE FROM THE REPORTER — on the repair, not the defect: deleting ③ would introduce a new inconsistency. §2.1's L1 row gives the L1→L2 upgrade trigger as 「10 個 random_state 兩兩 ARI 中位數 < 0.75」, and §2.2's stop-in-place example is 「未觀察到失效（10 seed ARI 中位數 0.88），因此不升級到兩階段」. Low ARI → 兩階段 is exactly §二's prescribed UPGRADE. So ③'s substance is methodologically correct (Ward-derived initial centroids genuinely remove seed variance); only its label is wrong. It is also not "lateral" as the reporter proposes — per §二 it is a bona fide upgrade. Correct fix: lift ③ out of the 降級 block, mark it an upgrade branch gated on n ≤ 3 萬, and log it as upgrade in degradation_log.md (neither downgrade nor lateral).

SEVERITY: important, matching the reporter. Not critical — no wrong number or business decision is produced (a small-n user following ③ gets a better model), and §二 is a ★ section earlier in the same file that a sequential reader passes first. But it is a self-contradiction on the skill's central organizing discipline, it mis-types the degradation_log.md row that exists specifically for auditability, and it hands a large-n user an unguarded path into a ~9 GB allocation. Not minor.

CHECKS RUN:
1. grep -rn "30k" over the entire skill: the token appears exactly once, only in the ASCII figure, with no derivation and no 【推導/教材/實測】 marker — in a document that marks every other threshold. It is unsupported anywhere.

file: skill/行銷數據分析/references/07_標籤與分群.md
locator: §6.1 HDBSCAN 參數段，min_cluster_size 公式下方那句
quote: 「`min_samples` 預設等於 `min_cluster_size`；要更保守（更多噪音）就調小。」
problem: 方向寫反了。min_samples 是核心距離的鄰居數：值愈大 → 核心距離愈大 → 愈多點密度不足以成群 → 愈多點被判噪音 → 愈保守。文件寫「調小」是相反的。後果不是小事：§6.3 用噪音佔比（<2% / 5–10% / >20%）當判讀依據，§6.2 又用「HDBSCAN 有沒有找到群」決定 A/B/C/D 四種情況走哪一條——把 min_samples 往錯方向調，噪音佔比就往錯方向跑，最後在「這批資料沒有密度結構」與「可以拿分群做決策」之間選錯邊。
how_verified: 由演算法定義直接推出：core_k(x) = 第 min_samples 近鄰的距離，對 min_samples 單調遞增；mutual reachability distance 隨之增大，稀疏區的點更難進入任何群。與 HDBSCAN 官方 Parameter Selection 及 sklearn.cluster.HDBSCAN（sklearn 1.7.2 已內建，環境可用）的一致行為相符。

LSD 與 Tukey 的分布前提相同（常態、等變異、獨立，共用 MSE 與 df=n−I —— 16 §8.3 的共同 t 統計量那一行就明寫兩者共用同一個 $t_{ij}$），差別只在臨界值：LSD 用 $t_{n-I,\alpha/2}$，Tukey 用 $q/\sqrt2$。換言之 LSD → Tukey 沒有拿掉任何前提，只是換了 FWER 控制方式 —— 正是 00 §1.6 自己舉的「換 LSD 為 SNK 不叫降級」那一類橫移。表中其他五列（組間差異 ANOVA→Welch→KW、CLV、分群、因果主張）都嚴格單調遞減前提，唯獨這一列在最左端破壞單調性。

我認真試過一個替代讀法幫它脫罪：LSD 帶有「只有 1–2 個事前登錄比較」這個**額外**前提，所以放最左也算「前提多」。這個讀法撐不住 —— (a) 這是設計期條件不是執行期前提，而 16 §8.4 的降級觸發條件明寫是「套件失敗、某群 n<5、變異數為 0」，不會有人跑到一半發現自己有 6 個比較才「降級」到 Tukey；(b) 表中其他列的最左端一律是「預設起點」（ANOVA、BG/NBD、兩階段分群、實驗），所以最左 = 預設，而 16 §8.3 白紙黑字說預設是 Tukey。

**3. 數字自算，正確**
`1−0.95^6 = 0.264908…`（k=4，$\binom42=6$）。另 k=3 → 14.3%，k=5 → 40.1%。包子報告正是 4 群 × 3 個獲利指標，屬於典型受害情境。

**4. 局部矛盾比對方講的更嚴重**
`07 §8.5` 在**同一節內自相矛盾**：506-511 行的 Levene 路由表寫「p > 0.05 同質 → one-way ANOVA → **Tukey HSD**」，隔 7 行的 515-519 降級階梯又寫「LSD → Tukey HSD → …」。同一節、同一情境、兩個相反的起點。而 `16:513` 的維護條款自己就寫著「四處分岔比四處都錯還糟」——這條缺陷正好撞在它自己定的紅線上。

**5. 對方有兩點論述我要修正（不影響結論）**
- 「LSD 落進規則縫隙裡完全不會被校正」**部分誇大**。`07 §8.5:523` 第②點是無條件的「同一族的多重比較做 BH-FDR 校正」，會蓋到 LSD。但這反而暴露第二層分岔：它與 `16 §8.4` 附加規則 1「Tukey／Games-Howell／Dunnett 之後不得再套 BH，只有手動 t 才需要 BH」在 Tukey 路徑上直接打架。所以不是「縫隙」，是「兩條互斥規則」。

**6. 素材面查證：LSD 打頭不是憑空捏造，但也不能為它辯護**
兩份素材確實分岔：`local/大數據行銷IB5082/04_期末報告樣本與報告文體.md:871` 說「LSD（最常見）、Tukey、Scheffé 皆可」，A+ 範本與包子自己的報告都用 LSD（SPSS 預設）；而 `notion/商管統計資料分析/01_eda_regression_anova.md:3154` 對 LSD 的原文評價是「**並沒有解決型一誤差率膨脹的問題，可以說是什麼都沒做**」，其 §10.11 檢核表（3988 行）明寫「只比 1~2 組事先規劃的 → Fisher's LSD／所有成對比較 → Tukey HSD（最推薦）」。skill 已經在 `16 §8.3/§8.4` 正確裁決過這個分岔（Tukey 預設、LSD 特例），但 00／07／10／18 四處的階梯沒跟著改 —— 這是**裁決沒有下推**的漏改，不是有意的設計。

**嚴重度：維持 important，不升級為 critical。**
升不上 critical 的理由：目前沒有任何程式會據此靜默算錯（stats_utils.py 未實作）；16 §8.4 決策樹是操作規格且正確；07 §8.5 的 Levene 表也把主線導向 Tukey；且 LSD 在課程評分脈絡下不會被判錯。
壓不到 minor 的理由：五份文件中四份把 LSD 放在預設位置，只有一份說預設是 Tukey，**多數指向錯的方向**；07 §8.5 節內十五行自相矛盾；而這是一份以「統計紀律」為賣點的 skill 的旗艦分析路徑（分群 × 獲利指標，k=3–4），照著做的 FWER 是 14–26%。

**建議修法我同意主體，但有兩點微調**：階梯統一為「Tukey HSD → Games-Howell → 手動獨立樣本 t（BH）→ 敘述統計對照表」即可；Dunn（BH）屬於 Kruskal-Wallis 之後的**分支**而非同一條直線上的一格，硬塞進主階梯會製造新的軸線混亂（`16 §8.4` 樹狀圖已正確處理）。另外 Bonferroni 在 `16 §8.3` 有一列（「要押大預算、一個都不能錯時」），修法時要一併決定它在階梯上的位置或明說它不在階梯上。最後，順手要修的是 `07 §8.5:523` 第②點與 `16 §8.4` 附加規則 1 的 BH 衝突。

file: skill/行銷數據分析/references/16_統計推論紀律.md
locator: §8.4 選擇與降級的決策樹，「所有成對比較」底下的三個分支
quote:
「├─ Levene p > 0.05（等變異）──► **Tukey HSD**（預設，n 不等自動走 Tukey–Kramer）
│           ├─ Levene p ≤ 0.05 或變異數比 ≥ 4
│           │     └─► Welch ANOVA + **Games-Howell**（見 05 §1.2）
│           └─ 常態也不成立（偏度 ≥ 1 且轉換無效）
│                 └─► Kruskal-Wallis + **Dunn（BH）**」
problem: 常態性與變異數同質是兩個獨立維度，樹卻把它們排成同一層的三個平行分支，導致不 MECE：「Levene p=0.30、偏度=2.5 且轉換無效」同時符合分支 1 與 3，按決策樹由上而下的語意會走分支 1，對嚴重偏態資料跑 Tukey；「Levene p=0.001、偏度=2.5」同時符合分支 2 與 3，走分支 2 的 Games-Howell（同樣假設常態）。結果是分支 3（KW+Dunn）永遠走不到——它唯一能成立的條件組合（Levene p>0.05 且變異數比<4 且常態不成立）已經被分支 1 攔截。KW+Dunn 在這棵樹裡是死碼。
how_verified: 對三個分支的條件做真值表；決策樹的預設語意是由上而下第一個成立者勝出，故第三分支的可達條件集合為空。
fix: 改成兩層（先常態、再變異數）：① 常態（偏度<1 或轉換有效）？ 是 → ② Levene p>0.05 且變異數比<4？ 是→Tukey HSD／否→Welch+Games-Howell；否 → ③ 變異數比<4？ 是→Kruskal-Wallis+Dunn(BH)／否→Welch+Games-Howell 或 bootstrap BCa 的成對均值差 CI（KW 在異方差下型一錯誤失控，見本清單第 1 條）。

verdict.reasoning:
我自己讀了 `E:\Projects\行銷分析\skill\行銷數據分析\references\11_行銷_成長與促銷.md` 第 129–201 行（§2.2、§2.4）、§八（641–674）、並在整個 repo grep 了「Stockpile / 囤貨 / 對照」，也去 17 §4.1（第 109–130 行）查了 λ_i 的定義。結論：核心缺陷成立，但對方的第一點推理有一處誤讀，我用自己查到的更強證據取代它。

**先講對方誤讀的地方（推翻其中一半）：**
§2.4 第一分支的「沒有對照組」指的是 DiD 意義下的「未上活動的可比單位（門市／地區／會員群）」，而 §2.2 的「對照」是同一份自家資料內部切出來的比較組。兩者不是同一個東西 —— 只有自家 pre-post 資料時，方法 B 在資料上不是「走不到」，只要有顧客層交易明細就切得出來。所以「走不到的路徑」這個框架不成立。

**但不一致本身是真的，而且比對方講的更嚴重（三處互相打架，不是兩處）：**
1. §2.2 L138：「兩個判斷方法，**兩個都要做**」（無條件）。
2. §2.4 L182–183 第一分支必做清單只有「季節去除 + Dip Ratio + 全額折讓成本」，沒有 Stockpile Index。
3. §2.4 L199 交付表自己寫「判定依據（Dip Ratio **或** Stockpile Index）」—— 同一節內「都要做」與「或」直接衝突。
4. §八 L646 的資料前提表把「促銷四成分」的最低條件寫成「檔期起訖 + 日層級營收」—— 日層級營收**根本支撐不了**方法 B（方法 B 要顧客層明細，且要求 n_intervals ≥ 5）；而該列唯一的降級路徑只處理「無檔期起訖」，完全沒有「做不出顧客層對照 → 方法 B 降級」這一條。
這在一份把「假設不成立就降級並說明」當核心原則、而且專門設了降級表的文件裡，是規格層級的漏洞，不是行文瑕疵。

**第二點（「對照」未定義）成立，且違反本文自己的規矩。** grep 全 repo：「對照」在 ref 11 只出現在 L157 這條式子與 §2.4/§五/§六的「對照組」語境，沒有任何一處定義 §2.2 的「對照」是誰；templates/ 也沒有對應 SQL。而 §1.2 L33 自己明文寫「四個集合的定義**必須寫進指標字典**，否則換個人重跑就對不上」。兩種自然讀法會給出不同結果：(a)「檔期內未購買者」—— 此時 g_i 的起算點兩組不可比，非購買者橫跨檔期的那段間隔是右設限／被拉長的，中位數偏大 → 分母偏大 → Stockpile Index 系統性偏小 → 把囤貨判成沒囤貨（對方的偏誤方向推導我自己驗過，正確）；(b)「檔期內以原價購買者」—— 起算點可比，偏誤小得多。文件沒說是哪一種，而 17 §4.1 的 λ_i 只是平均間隔，沒有任何 anchor 規範可以補上。

**第三點（缺證據等級標註）成立但最弱。** §2.4 L177 已有概括條款「§二的所有數字，在沒有對照組的情況下一律標『相關』」，形式上蓋得到 Stockpile Index。真正的風險是命名衝突：方法 B 名義上「有對照」，讀者容易認為它不適用該條款、甚至誤掛到 §2.4 第二分支去主張準實驗。L159「顯著 > 1 表示囤貨」是唯一沒帶標籤的因果式斷言（相較之下 L153 連 0.3/0.8 門檻都標了【推導，待驗證】），這個不對稱是真的。

**嚴重度維持 important，不升 critical。** 理由是我自己追了下游影響：pull-forward 與囤貨在 L134–135 的表裡**對 ROI 的處置完全相同（兩者都「不算」）**，而總量層的 Dip Ratio（方法 A）獨立成立、§2.3 的淨值公式也不吃方法 B 的輸出。所以就算 Stockpile Index 被偏誤成低估，錯的是「四成分歸屬表」的成分標籤，不是淨值與加碼／停辦的決策數字 —— 這條金流路徑仍被方法 A 守住。因此是 ★ 節裡一個「必做步驟的關鍵輸入未定義 + 文件三處自相矛盾 + 缺降級條款」的規格缺陷，該修，但不到會直接算錯錢的 critical。

對方的建議修法方向正確，我會再加兩項：§八 L646 那一列要同步補「無顧客層明細或無法定義可比對照 → 方法 B 標 N/A，pull-forward 與囤貨合併報告」；§2.4 L199 的「或」要與 §2.2 的措辭統一，否則改完仍然對不上。

file: skill/行銷數據分析/references/10_行銷_購物籃與品類.md
locator: §8.3 兩條合法路線表的路線 B 那列
quote: 「| **B** | 因素分數 | 品類滲透率、客單價、品類廣度 $k_i$ | 分群依「消費人格」，再問「這幾群人的價值指標有沒有差」。**應變數需與因素分數非同源** |」
problem: 因素分數是對品類滲透率矩陣做因素分析得到的，它是那些品類滲透率的線性組合（載荷加權）。所以「品類滲透率」與「因素分數」是最同源的一對，不是非同源；「品類廣度 k_i」也是同一張滲透率矩陣的列摘要。用因素分數分群、再拿原始品類滲透率跑 ANOVA，就是 §8.3 開頭那段警告的完全相同的循環（「你只是在檢定 k-means 有沒有把資料分開，而它當然分開了」）。同一個格子裡先寫出禁令、再給出違反禁令的例子。§九 的 verify 條目「分群輸入與 ANOVA 應變數非同源」是一句自然語言，擋不住「名稱不同但血緣相同」的情況。
how_verified: 由因素分析的定義推出：因素分數 f_ij = Σ_c w_jc·z_ic，其中 z_ic 為標準化後的品類滲透率（ref 10 §六 的因素分析輸入即為品類層滲透率矩陣，18-E12 亦規定因素分析必須在品類層級）。線性組合與其組成分量的同源性是定義層面的。
fix: 路線 B 的應變數欄改成「後續期間的實際消費（as_of 之後）、回應率、CAC、退貨率、客服接觸次數——一律為未進因素分析矩陣的變數。❌ 不可用品類滲透率（因素分數即為其線性組合）、不可用品類廣度 k_i（同一張滲透率矩陣的列摘要）」。並把 verify 那條改成可執行的血緣檢查：assert set(factor_input_cols) & set(anova_dv_cols) == set()，factor_input_cols 從 factor_spec.json 讀。

verdict.reasoning: 已自行核對 skill/行銷數據分析/references/10_行銷_購物籃與品類.md §8.3 該列，並回查 §6.2、§6.3、§6.4、§6.5、§7.3、§8.2、§九，以及 07_標籤與分群.md §8.2（S1）與 18_分析陷阱清單.md E2/E12。結論：聲稱成立。(1) 因素分析的輸入就是顧客 × 品類的二元滲透率矩陣——§6.2 的程式碼寫明 `pen = X.mean()  # 二元矩陣的欄平均 = 滲透率`，且 §6.4/§8.2 都把「顧客 × 品類滲透率」當成無因素分數時的同位替代物，證明兩者是同一張表的降維前後兩種表示。(2) §6.3 指定 PCA + Varimax，因素分數 f_ij = Σ_c w_jc·z_ic 是標準化滲透率欄的線性組合；k-means 在該子空間最大化 BGSS/WGSS，而原始欄 z_c 的子空間投影部分正是被最佳化的量（載荷 > 0.4 的品類共同性高，投影主導），故對品類滲透率跑 ANOVA 的 F 被灌水——這正是 §8.3 開頭警告與 07 §8.2 S1（素材列為 critical）禁止的循環推論。(3) 品類廣度 k_i 依 §7.3 是同一張二元矩陣的列加總（等權線性組合），同源。(4) 因此該格先寫「應變數需與因素分數非同源」、再把三個候選中的兩個列成違反該禁令的例子，只有「客單價」（金額面、未進矩陣）合法，屬自相矛盾，照表操作會產出 §8.4 那張帶 F/p/η²/事後分組的無效統計表。(5) 防呆確實漏接：本檔 §九 是自然語言，07 §8.2 的可執行 gate 是 set(cluster_input_vars) & set(anova_tested_vars)，欄名不同（factor_* vs pen_cat_*）交集必為空，血緣同源攔不住；建議的修法方向與 07 §8.2 既有的「分群用 as_of 前、檢定用 as_of 後」解法一致。唯一可能的辯護（把「品類滲透率」讀成品類層級純量）反而讓該格在另一個意義上更錯：純量無法當 ANOVA 應變數，而群層滲透率就是輸入欄的群平均，循環性相同。嚴重度維持 important 而非 critical：路線 B 非預設（預設路線 A 無此問題），且正確禁令就寫在同一格內，仍有被察覺的機會；但會直接產出無效統計主張且既有 gate 擋不住，遠超 minor。

失敗模式是**大聲失敗**而非靜默錯誤。ProjectPaths.figure()/table()（行 202-206）只做路徑串接、不 mkdir，因此寫進 `圖表/分布/` 會在第一次存檔時直接 FileNotFoundError。不會產生錯的數字、不會靜默少算、不會資料損毀——而這份 skill 自己認定的最貴失效（03 開頭的 union_by_name 讓 ROAS 從 1.6 算成 3.2、18-E7 圖文相反）都屬於靜默錯數字那一類，這條不是。另外 19 §6.2 / 03 §1.3 反覆引用的 verify_outputs.py、collect_figures.py、collect_report_figures.py 在 scripts/ 底下根本不存在（只有 anonymize_pii.py、db.py、paths.py、setup_check.py），所以「hash 一致性檢查會壞掉」目前還不成立。
